headline_hook: Gemma 4 Drops Encoder-Free, Ideogram Goes Open-Weight, and Anthropic Maps Real AI Attacks
preview_topics: how attackers actually use AI in the wild

pick_of_the_day.thesis: 832 real-world malicious accounts mapped onto MITRE ATT&CK reveal that the actual AI threat surface looks nothing like the hypothetical risks dominating policy debates — and the gap between perceived and real AI-enabled attacks should force every security team to reprioritize.

model_literacy.relevance: Gemma 4 processes text, images, and video through a single decoder-only transformer — no separate vision encoder, no CLIP adapter, no modality-specific heads. Understanding why this matters: fewer moving parts means easier fine-tuning, smaller deployment footprint, and one unified attention space where the model can reason across modalities natively instead of stitching representations together.

items.title: Gemma 4 12B Ships Encoder-Free Multimodal With Open Weights
